IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Hurst, Sullivan, Roach, and Simpson

Bill.BriefDescription: Designating state route number 164 as a highway of statewide significance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating state route number 164 as a highwayof statewide significance; and adding a new section to chapter 47.05RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature designates state route number 164, as defined inRCW 47.17.320, as a highway of statewide significance.
